headline.text: Three damaged belts flagged across L1 and L3 — *plastic fragments* could enter product if not addressed.

summary: Three belt damage findings: L1 S1 blue conveyor and inclusion hopper belts developing holes, L3 MFM plastic cover flipped proactively. Four pallets from L3 Truffle Line on hold for hard texture after coconut oil outage. Three sanitation gaps: L3 ML1 PTL parts left dirty by washroom, Sweco reinstalled dirty, and L2 environmental swab OOS.

holds.title: 4 pallets held for hard texture after oil outage
holds.summary: Coconut oil ran out at Truffle Line; centers deposited without oil for ~30 minutes, resulting in harder texture on final product — organoleptic testing flagged texture as off.
holds.status: On hold pending Monday evaluation by Preston and Kathleen.

food_safety.title: Blue belt developing holes on S1 M9/M10 conveyor
food_safety.summary: Short blue belt immediately after white U-shaped belt above Matrices 9 & 10 showing deterioration and developing holes — potential plastic contamination hazard if fragments detach.
food_safety.status: Escalated to E&C; maintenance cannot repair this belt type — replacement required.

food_safety.title: Inclusion hopper blue belt also damaged
food_safety.summary: Inclusion hopper belt on S1 showing similar damage — maintenance will trim the damaged section as temporary fix.
food_safety.status: Maintenance trimming belt; permanent replacement needed.

food_safety.title: MFM plastic cover flipped to prevent FM risk
food_safety.summary: Plastic cover on MFM showing wear and tear that could cause plastic fragments to fall into bags — cover flipped upside down proactively, replacement ordered.
food_safety.status: Resolved on shift — cover flipped, replacement on order.

quality.title: Truffle centers too hard after oil outage
quality.summary: Coconut oil supply exhausted at Truffle Line for approximately 30 minutes; centers deposited without oil resulted in harder texture that failed organoleptic testing.
quality.status: Line recovered after oil refilled and 40-minute mix; 4 pallets held for Monday review.

sanitation.title: Environmental swab OOS requires 3x cleaning
sanitation.summary: Out-of-spec environmental swab result flagged; protocol requires clean, vector, clean, vector, clean, vector before release.
sanitation.status: Investigation ongoing — first cleaning completed, awaiting vector results.

sanitation.title: PTL filter/pipes left dirty after washroom clean
sanitation.summary: PTL filter gasket, base, and pipe moved from washroom to ML1 line still had hardened chocolate on them — parts sent back for cleaning before install.
sanitation.status: Resolved — parts recleaned, ATP tested, and installed.

sanitation.title: ML1 Sweco dirty at startup, reinstalled dirty
sanitation.summary: Sweco found dirty during 1st-shift startup; removed, cleaned, and reinstalled — indicates missed step during prior cleaning.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Sweco cleaned and reinstalled; visual inspection and ATP passed.

sanitation.title: Water intrusion by QA area
sanitation.summary: Water seeping in near QA area during rain event; spill kit placed and water mopped up.
sanitation.status: Resolved on shift — door seal replacement scheduled for next week.

opportunities.text: Consider adding belt-wear inspection to pre-op checklist for S1 — today's two damaged blue belts (M9/M10 conveyor and inclusion hopper) both presented FM contamination risk.
Review washroom cleaning verification procedure for complex assemblies — PTL filter/pipe left with hardened chocolate after cleaning suggests gap in inspection or final rinse.
Add visual check for Sweco cleanliness to ML1 pre-startup checklist — equipment reinstalled dirty today, requiring mid-shift removal and re-clean.
Consider oil-level monitoring or low-level alarm for Truffle Line coconut oil tank — 30-minute oil outage resulted in 4 pallets on hold for texture defects.
